title: Carbide-reinforced Re0.1Hf0.25NbTaW0.4 refractory high-entropy alloy with excellent room and elevated temperature mechanical properties
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting using a DHL1250 vacuum arc furnace with purities of Hf, Nb, Ta, W, and Re higher than 99.95 wt%. The C element was added as NbC powder (5 μm, 99.9 wt%). The NbC powder was wrapped in Nb foil and melted with pure metal particles. Ingots were melted five times for homogeneity and anneal-rolled.
